input: Pack a go-bag for each family member this week

gold.taskTitle: Pack a go-bag for every family member
gold.taskDescription: Prepare a ready-to-grab emergency or travel bag for each member of the family within this week.

questions.title: How many people are you packing go-bags for?
questions.description: Understanding the number of family members helps determine the scale of the task.

questions.title: What is the primary purpose of these go-bags?
questions.description: Is this for emergency preparedness, natural disasters, quick travel, or another specific scenario?

questions.title: How many days of supplies should each bag cover?
questions.description: The duration (e.g., 24 hours, 72 hours, one week) directly shapes what goes inside each bag.

questions.title: Do any family members have special medical or dietary needs?
questions.description: Knowing about medications, allergies, or dietary restrictions ensures each bag is properly tailored.

questions.title: Do you already own any supplies or bags to use?
questions.description: Identifying what is already on hand avoids duplicate purchases and saves time.

questions.title: What is your budget for buying missing items?
questions.description: A clear spending limit will guide decisions on what to purchase versus substitute.

questions.title: Where will the go-bags be stored once packed?
questions.description: The storage location affects bag size, weight limits, and how accessible items need to be.
